10 Things You MUST Do in Hanoi on Your First Trip (Don't Miss #3 After Dark!)

Planning your first trip to Hanoi? This practical Hanoi travel guide covers the best things to do in Hanoi, Vietnam — from the famous Hoan Kiem Lake and Hanoi Train Street to historic temples, Vietnamese street food, and the atmospheric Old Quarter.

Hanoi has a fascinating mix of history, culture, food, and everyday city life, but choosing what to see matters if you only have a few days. We've narrowed it down to 10 experiences we'd prioritize on a first visit, including one special evening experience you shouldn't miss. We'll also share practical tips to help you plan your Hanoi itinerary, avoid wasted time, and make the most of your trip.
______________________________________________________________

🏙️ 10 Best Things to Do in Hanoi, Vietnam:

1. Imperial Citadel of Thang Long
2. Tran Quoc Pagoda & West Lake
3. Hoa Lo Prison Museum
4. Temple of Literature
5. Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum Complex
6. Hanoi Train Street
7. Traditional Water-Puppet Show
8. Hoan Kiem Lake After Dark
9. Try Hanoi's Street-Food Specialties
10. Explore Hanoi's Old Quarter

We'll also show you how we'd group these attractions geographically, so you can spend less time travelling across Hanoi and more time enjoying its history, food, and local atmosphere. Before visiting Hanoi Train Street, check the latest access restrictions and follow local safety instructions.
